title: 19044 - 19044/P2612/009746
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Air Conditioner Compressor fails to operate
commonCauses: Faulty wiring or connection(s) to the N280 - A/C Compressor Regulator Valve
Faulty N280 - A/C Compressor Regulator Valve
stepByStepSolution: Repair Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri or Connection(s) to the N280 - A/C Compressor Regulator Valve
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  A/C Compressor or N280 - A/C Compressor Regulator Valve (if available)
technicalNotes: When found in VW New Beetle with 2.5L, check the wiring and the 4-pin connector near the starter for damage or stress.
